records.jp: 広ーい！　何して遊ぶ？
records.en_original: Wow, this place is huge! What do you wanna do?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, this place is huge! What do you wanna do?
records.en: Wow, this place is huge! What do you wanna do?

records.jp: 早速だね
records.en_original: Someone's excited.
records.en_auxiliary: Someone's excited.
records.en: Someone's excited.

records.jp: んー……でも、二人だとやれること限られてるよね
records.en_original: Hmm... I guess there are only a few things we can do with just the two of us.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I guess there are only a few things we can do with just the two of us.
records.en: Hmm... I guess there are only a few things we can do with just the two of us.

records.jp: 鬼ごっこ……とか？
records.en_original: What about...tag?
records.en_auxiliary: What about...tag?
records.en: What about...tag?

records.jp: いや、二人だと遊びにならないでしょ！
records.en_original: We can't play tag with only two people!
records.en_auxiliary: We can't play tag with only two people!
records.en: We can't play tag with only two people!

records.jp: ほら、カップルとかがやる<CR>「捕まえてごらーん！」的な？
records.en_original: Why not, couples do it! "Come and get me," that kind of thing!
records.en_auxiliary: Why not, couples do it! "Come and get me," that kind of thing!
records.en: You know, like couples do—<CR>“Come and catch me~!”

records.jp: それ、遊びじゃないし……。<CR>体育館でやってどうするのさ
records.en_original: That's...not the kind of game I was thinking of. Besides, there has to be more you can do in a gym.
records.en_auxiliary: That's...not the kind of game I was thinking of. Besides, there has to be more you can do in a gym.
records.en: That's...not the kind of game I was thinking of.<CR>Besides, there has to be more you can do in a gym.

records.jp: だよねー……
records.en_original: True...
records.en_auxiliary: True...
records.en: True...

records.jp: 普通にボールとかで遊ぼうかー
records.en_original: We could just play a ball game, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: We could just play a ball game, I guess.
records.en: We could just play a ball game, I guess.

records.jp: 二人でやるなら……やっぱり卓球とか？
records.en_original: How about ping-pong, then?
records.en_auxiliary: How about ping-pong, then?
records.en: How about ping-pong, then?

records.jp: おー、いいね！<CR>道具とかちゃんとあるかな
records.en_original: Oh, good idea! I wonder if they have everything we need.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, good idea! I wonder if they have everything we need.
records.en: Oh, good idea! I wonder<CR>if they have everything we need.

records.jp: ……卓球台はあるのに、<CR>ラケットとボールが無いなんて……
records.en_original: So they have a ping-pong table, but no rackets or balls...
records.en_auxiliary: So they have a ping-pong table, but no rackets or balls...
records.en: So they have a ping-pong<CR>table, but no rackets or balls...

records.jp: んんー……そうだ！<CR>代わりにスリッパとかで打ち合うのは？
records.en_original: Hmm... Oh! Why don't we use slippers for rackets?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Oh! Why don't we use slippers for rackets?
records.en: Hmm... Oh! Why<CR>don't we use slippers for rackets?

records.jp: ボールは？
records.en_original: And what about the ball?
records.en_auxiliary: And what about the ball?
records.en: And what about the ball?

records.jp: 他にボールって言ったら……<CR>バスケのボールくらいしかないや
records.en_original: A ball, huh... All I can find is a basketball.
records.en_auxiliary: A ball, huh... All I can find is a basketball.
records.en: A ball, huh... All I<CR>can find is a basketball.

records.jp: ……スリッパでバスケットボールを打ち合う卓球！<CR>新しい！
records.en_original: A new kind of ping-pong, using slippers and a basketball. Sounds fun to me!
records.en_auxiliary: A new kind of ping-pong, using slippers and a basketball. Sounds fun to me!
records.en: A new kind of ping-pong, using slippers and a basketball. Sounds<CR>fun to me!

records.jp: 卓球台壊れちゃうね
records.en_original: I think that'd break the table.
records.en_auxiliary: I think that'd break the table.
records.en: I think that'd break the table.

records.jp: ……素直にバスケでもしようか
records.en_original: ...Let's just play basketball, shall we?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Let's just play basketball, shall we?
records.en: ...Let's just play basketball, shall we?

records.jp: ふう……はあ……。ちょっとタンマ、疲れた……
records.en_original: *Huff huff* Timeout! I need to catch my breath...
records.en_auxiliary: *Huff huff* Timeout! I need to catch my breath...
records.en: *Huff huff* Timeout! I need to catch my breath...

records.jp: 勇希、大丈夫？　ちょっと休憩にしよっか
records.en_original: Are you okay, Yuki? Let's take a break.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you okay, Yuki? Let's take a break.
records.en: Are you okay, Yuki? Let's take a break.

records.jp: うん……ごめん……
records.en_original: Yeah... Sorry...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... Sorry...
records.en: Yeah... Sorry...

records.jp: いいよいいよ。<CR>何なら膝枕してあげよっか？
records.en_original: No problem. Do you want to lay your head in my lap?
records.en_auxiliary: No problem. Do you want to lay your head in my lap?
records.en: It is fine, it is fine.<CR>Want me to give you a lap pillow?

records.jp: ありがとー……。<CR>でも汗だくだからさすがにやめとく……
records.en_original: Thanks... But I'm super sweaty, maybe I shouldn't.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks... But I'm super sweaty, maybe I shouldn't.
records.en: Thanks... But I'm<CR>super sweaty, maybe I shouldn't.

records.jp: もうバテちゃったの？<CR>まだまだだなー
records.en_original: Tired already? Come on, you can't throw in the towel yet!
records.en_auxiliary: Tired already? Come on, you can't throw in the towel yet!
records.en: Tired already? Come on, you can't<CR>throw in the towel yet!

records.jp: な、何をー！　……う
records.en_original: Wh-what... Oof...
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what... Oof...
records.en: Wh-what... Oof...

records.jp: わあ、ちょっと大丈夫？<CR>冗談だって。疲れたなら休憩しよ
records.en_original: Aaah, are you okay?! I was just messing around. Let's take a break.
records.en_auxiliary: Aaah, are you okay?! I was just messing around. Let's take a break.
records.en: Aaah, are you okay?! I was<CR>just messing around. Let's take a break.

records.jp: ごめん……ちょっと休む……
records.en_original: Sorry... Just give me a sec...
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry... Just give me a sec...
records.en: Sorry... Just give me a sec...

records.jp: はふう……。もうダメ、しばらく立てない……
records.en_original: Phew... I'm done. I don't think I can stand.
records.en_auxiliary: Phew... I'm done. I don't think I can stand.
records.en: Phew... I'm done. I don't think I can stand.

records.jp: あはは。もう……全力で遊びすぎ
records.en_original: Ahaha. Jeez... You really can never hold back, can you?
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha. Jeez... You really can never hold back, can you?
records.en: Ahaha. Jeez... You really can never hold back, can you?

records.jp: だって、楽しいんだもん
records.en_original: But I was having so much fun!
records.en_auxiliary: But I was having so much fun!
records.en: But I was having so much fun!

records.jp: ふふ、私も楽しいよ。<CR>勇希って何でも楽しそうにやるから、ついつられちゃう
records.en_original: Hehe, me too. You always look like you're having so much fun, I couldn't help but get carried away too.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, me too. You always look like you're having so much fun, I couldn't help but get carried away too.
records.en: Hehe, me too. You always look<CR>like you're having so much fun, I couldn't help but get carried away too.

records.jp: やるなら楽しまないと損だからね！
records.en_original: No point in doing something if you can't have fun with it!
records.en_auxiliary: No point in doing something if you can't have fun with it!
records.en: No point in doing something if you can't have fun with it!

records.jp: それに、愛央がノッてくれるからっていうのもあるよ。<CR>付き合ってくれてありがとね！
records.en_original: But it wouldn't have been nearly as much fun without you. Thanks for playing with me!
records.en_auxiliary: But it wouldn't have been nearly as much fun without you. Thanks for playing with me!
records.en: But it wouldn't have been nearly as much fun without you.<CR>Thanks for playing with me!

records.jp: どういたしまして
records.en_original: You're welcome.
records.en_auxiliary: You're welcome.
records.en: You're welcome.

records.jp: よーし、一休みしたらまた遊ぶぞー！
records.en_original: All right, let's take a quick break and get back to it!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, let's take a quick break and get back to it!
records.en: All right, let's take a quick break and get back to it!

records.jp: だからって無理しないでね。<CR>無理して倒れたら台無しだよ
records.en_original: Hey, don't overdo it! Nothing ruins a fun time like someone passing out from exhaustion.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, don't overdo it! Nothing ruins a fun time like someone passing out from exhaustion.
records.en: Hey, don't overdo it! Nothing ruins a fun time<CR>like someone passing out from exhaustion.

records.jp: うん……。<CR>あんま体力ないのは自覚してるんだけどねー
records.en_original: Yeah... I know I'm not exactly in the best of shape.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I know I'm not exactly in the best of shape.
records.en: Yeah... I<CR>know I'm not exactly in the best of shape.

records.jp: あたしがあんま無理しないように、<CR>愛央がちゃんと見ててよ
records.en_original: So you have to watch me to make sure I don't get carried away!
records.en_auxiliary: So you have to watch me to make sure I don't get carried away!
records.en: So you have to watch me to make sure<CR>I don't get carried away!

records.jp: そんな保護者みたいな……
records.en_original: What am I, your mother...?
records.en_auxiliary: What am I, your mother...?
records.en: What am I, your mother...?

records.jp: ママー！　のどかわいたー！
records.en_original: Mooom! I'm thirsty!
records.en_auxiliary: Mooom! I'm thirsty!
records.en: Mama! I'm thirsty!

records.jp: ああ、はいはい……買ってくるよ。何がいい？
records.en_original: Okay, okay. Mommy will get you a drink. What do you want?
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, okay. Mommy will get you a drink. What do you want?
records.en: Yes, yes... I will go get one. What do you want?

records.jp: 普通に返さないでよー！
records.en_original: Ew, don't play along!
records.en_auxiliary: Ew, don't play along!
records.en: Do not answer me normally!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
